facts.business: Power & Instrumentation (Gujarat) Limited is an electrical EPC and infrastructure solutions company operating across electrical EPC, airport infrastructure, EHV infrastructure, solar EPC, industrial & commercial electrical services, backup power & standby systems, and manufacturing integration through Peaton Electricals Company Limited.

guidance_or_targets.statement: For FY 2025-26, our theme, 'DNA of Growth,' captures the essence of this evolution. It is built on three enduring pillars of Dependability, Network, and Agility which continue to define our brand and guide our strategy.

key_risks: Revenue recognition for construction contracts involves significant judgments, identification of contractual obligations, scope amendments, and price escalations resulting in revised contract price.
